nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The Radio Mast crackles. Pell is on the stool beneath it, headphones far too big.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: It's doing the thing again. The hissing thing.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: —anyone on this band, this is Lantern. If you can hear me, don't answer on this channel. Switch to four-four.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: She said four-four. Is that a number or a — okay, okay, I got it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: ...Huh. Okay. Hi. You're the first voice I've heard in two years that wasn't singing.

choices.text: We don't have time for this. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Someone with a radio and a lot of free time. Call me Lantern.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Channel nine. The Linked. They do it when the Network is thinking. Don't listen to it for long.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Fair. Straight to business. I like you already.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Your signal's weak. There's a relay shed on your doorstep, north of the gardens. Dead Network hardware, but the antenna's good.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Bring it home and I can reach you anywhere in the valley. And I can send you things.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: What kind of things?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Plans, kid. How to build stuff. First lesson's free.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Take two people. Weapons. Pick up the antenna, walk out the way you came. That's the whole job.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Okay. Antenna's up. Oh, that's clean. I can hear your mast hum.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: I put a little extra on the line for you. Watchtower plans. If the shed heard you, something else did too.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Is that the free lesson?

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: That's the free lesson. Next ones cost you a favour.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The kind where you go places I can't. Not today. Build yourselves a Med Bay. Somebody's going to need it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: Underground. Safe. Bored. Next question.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: And put a kid on the farm. Small hands, big harvest. That's not a saying. I just made it up. Lantern out.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: You alive? ...Good. The antenna's still there. Problem is, so is everything that heard you.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The shed's full now. More Husks inside. Go slower this time. Watch the loop.
